result.reason: The redline adds the core performance, Site-conformance, legal-compliance and malicious-code warranties and supplies a ninety-day Site warranty, but it reaches neither complete position. It omits an express duration for the Services warranty, provides only ninety days rather than twelve months for preferred software coverage, and does not clearly extend the refund remedy to a nonconforming Site or separately paid software. The remedy sentence is also ambiguous because it refers to “this warranty” in the singular and places all remedy selection solely at HDI's option. The existing mutual representations and Globix provision remain effective without apparent contradiction.
